panels.narration: Long after the campus has gone quiet, Ananya burns the midnight oil in the university's advanced computing lab.
panels.dialogue: Just a few more lines of code, and this algorithm should finally work...

panels.narration: A sudden, low hum breaks the silence, drawing her attention toward the forgotten storage units in the back.
panels.dialogue: What on earth? Did someone leave a server rack running?

panels.narration: Stepping away from her desk, she moves into the deeper shadows where the air feels charged with an unfamiliar energy.
Tucked away behind obsolete hardware lies a masterpiece of alien engineering—stirring to life.
panels.dialogue: No way... this technology isn't from any lab on this planet.

panels.narration: As the machine opens its glowing optics, a new chapter of discovery begins.
